details:
I run a low-end PC a potato I can't run any modern games 

and that especially goes for PCVR games the way I solve this is though "Cloud Gaming"

where I can rent out a $3000 PC with RTX 4080 and Ryzen 9 for just $20 a month saving much more overtime then building that $3000 PC now I can run games at peak resolution with peaked graphical settings simply enjoy the games at its PEAK QUALITY, however with anything good there are draw backs that being limited library that can only be expanded when the service makes deals with other gaming companies or when ambitious indie developers negotiate with them on adding support to their game,

you guys should negotiate adding VRchat to some popular cloud gaming services! 

Start with the best "Geforce Now" its what anyone in the scene uses including me. 

IMAGINE the thousands of Quest users who go around experiencing your game

at its lowest due to the Quest's limitations then to their shock they read VRchat 

recently partnered with cloud gaming services, so they get on their Chromebook launch up their service connect the Quest then BOOM they're playing on the latest hardware running insane frames enjoying the game at its PEAK QUALITY... 

THINK OF THE BROKIE QUEST USERS! 

All the more people that will come to the game, all the more who will enjoy it
title: "Cloud Gaming" The Future allowing a Potato to be a NASA PC
